Sonet HTK (O) price starts at Rs. 10.44 Lakh and goes up to Rs. 13.42 Lakh. The EMI for Sonet HTK (O) starts from Rs. 19,964. The key features available in Sonet HTK (O) are 8-inch touchscreen, Rear AC vents, Steering controls, Keyless entry, Body-coloured mirrors. As per ARAI, Sonet HTK (O) has a certified mileage of 18.6 kmpl for Diesel Automatic (TC) 1493 cc.
